verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's task creation and workspace configuration are driven by natural-language prompts to underlying agents (e.g. doc-11 shows a multi-repo workspace being configured via a plain-English instruction, and tasks/sessions are launched via prompt-driven agent runs across Claude Code, Codex, Bedrock). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and a dedicated doc framing NL as the primary control surface rather than agent-task prompting.
